jobs.description:
Our client is a large Belgian organization with an extensive and business-critical IT environment. Within the infrastructure department, work is being done on various strategic programs concerning hybrid cloud, middleware, integration platforms, networking, and cybersecurity.To further structure multiple infrastructure projects and interdependencies, they are seeking an experienced IT Infrastructure Project Manager who takes ownership of planning, stakeholders, and delivery within the domains of AppStack, Network Security, and Networking.
Jobomschrijving
Here, you assume end-to-end management of multiple complex infrastructure projects within a hybrid enterprise environment.You coordinate projects related to middleware, integration, automation, networking, and network security, ensuring that technical teams and vendors remain aligned. You translate the various project lines into concrete plans, milestones, and deliverables, and closely monitor these using tools including MS Project and Jira.You guide technical teams during implementations, migrations, and infrastructure changes, while monitoring schedules, scope, budget, resources, risks, and dependencies.You organize alignment and synchronization meetings, maintain coherence between different initiatives, and ensure transparent communication with stakeholders and management.Additionally, you oversee governance, documentation, compliance, and security requirements.

•  5y experience as Project Manager in IT-infra
• You are strong in stakeholder management and diplomacy
• Broad technical knowledge of infrastructure, cloud, middleware, integration, and security 
• Trilingual environment (English, Dutch & French): you should at least understand (not speak) them at a basic level and master one

This large Belgian company plays a key role and manages an extensive and technically complex network. Behind the scenes, high-performing and reliable IT systems ensure that operational processes run safely and efficiently. Within this business-critical environment, significant investments are being made in modern software development and sustainable IT architecture.You will join an experienced team operating in an Enterprise environment where quality, collaboration, and long-term vision are central.
Jobomschrijving
As Lead Full Stack Developer, you take a key role in the further development and evolution of a suite of business-critical applications used in real-time operational environments.You remain strongly hands-on in both backend and frontend development, working primarily with .NET and Angular, while also guiding technical choices, improving existing implementations and helping shape upcoming solutions. You challenge current approaches where needed and translate complex technical topics into clear and pragmatic proposals.A major part of the role is technical leadership. You support and coach other developers, promote knowledge sharing and help maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability and software design. You work closely with analysts, architects, testers and other developers within an Agile/Scrum setup.You also keep a close eye on delivery, scope and technical risks. When dependencies, architectural concerns or implementation issues arise, you identify them early and help the team move towards a robust and sustainable solution.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience in .NET & Angular
•  15 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Your responsibilities as a Senior Treasury Analyst :

• Manage liquidity, cash flow planning and day-to-day treasury operations across multiple entities.
• Oversee international banking relationships, cross-border payments and multi-currency activities.
• Develop and improve treasury processes, policies and internal controls.
• Work with Treasury Management Systems.
• Support treasury transformation through automation, system improvements and process standardisation.
• Analyse and optimise treasury data.
• Collaborate with Finance and other stakeholders across an international organisation.
• Contribute to treasury activities in a rapidly evolving, high-growth environment.
 

 

About the candidate :

• You have minimum 5 years of experience in corporate treasury or cash management within an international, multi-entity environment.
• You bring strong expertise in liquidity management, treasury operations and international banking.
• You have hands-on experience with a Treasury Management System.
• You have experience improving treasury processes, policies and control frameworks.
• You bring a proactive, structured and accountable approach, with the ability to work independently.
• You are a strong team player who communicates effectively across different functions and stakeholders.
• You are comfortable working in a fast-changing and sometimes ambiguous environment.
• You speak fluent English; no other languages are required.

jobs.occupation: Budget Analyst at the U.S. Embassy in Belgium
jobs.description:
The U.S. Embassy in Brussels is looking for a Budget Analyst to join the Federal Aviation Administration.

Jobomschrijving

The job holder maintains budgets for all FAA lines of business in Brussels and FAA Representative offices located in Paris, Abu Dhabi, Dakar, Warsaw, and London. The budget management function includes expenditure forecasting, multi-year budget estimation, yearly travel budget development, expenditure tracking including travel burn rates, budget reconciliation, approval of payments, and submission of quarterly and close-out reports.

EDUCATION (multiple options): 2 years of University studies in any field or university degree in finance, accounting, business administration

EXPERIENCE: 2-5 years in finance, accounting, or business administration.

LANGUAGE: Fluency in English, French and Dutch.

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. Through this work, they make a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

They are currently in a phase of significant growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Do you have experience working in a warehouse or in logistics in general? Then we are looking for you!

In this role, you’ll be part of a supportive and collaborative team within an international pharmaceutical production company.

As a Warehouse Associate you'll manage the following:

• You take care of everything that comes in and goes out of the company and ensure that every step is properly documented.
• You handle inventory receipts and transactions related to inbound, picking, and outbound operations.  
• You receive and inspect biological products in a temperature-controlled environment, ensuring all GMP/GDP procedures are followed.  
• You safely handle all materials and ensure they are stored correctly.  
• You perform inventory checks to maintain stock accuracy and support order picking and packing activities.

• 
You have experience in logistics or warehouse work.

• 
You are looking for a long- term job, and you are enthousiastic to learn new skills. 

• 
You pay attention to detail and like to work accurately.

• 
You follow procedures carefully to ensure product quality and your own safety.

• 
You enjoy working in a team and support your colleagues.

• 
You communicate well in English.

• 
You can travel to work with your own transportation method.

• 
You are comfortable using a computer and Microsoft Office.

We are looking for an experienced cleaning operator for a large international manufacturing company in Desteldonk, active in the production of high-quality components for the automotive industry. 
This position offers a quick start and a temporary contract until 31 January 2027. 
 

Your Responsibilities
 
 

• Cleaning and maintaining sanitary facilities (toilets). 

• Cleaning and maintaining staff canteens and break rooms. 

• Ensuring a clean, hygienic, and pleasant working environment  

Working Hours
 
 

• Monday to Friday 

• 6:00 PM to 9:00PM 

• Part-time schedule (15 hours per week) 
 

Are you the candidate we are looking for? 
You have your own transportation to reach the site. The location is not accessible by public transport. 
You have previous experience in professional cleaning and are familiar with cleaning colour codes. 
Experience with cleaning machines is an advantage, but not required. 
You speak very good English. You are service-minded and customer-oriented. 
You are willing to work on a temporary basis and can commit until 31 January 2027. 
You are available to work every weekday from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM and are comfortable working part-time.

Our client is a specialized consultancy company with a unique market position, having worked exclusively with the same international aviation industry leader for more than 15 years. This long-term partnership offers an exceptional combination of stability, expertise, and continuous technological evolution.Operating within a highly international environment, the company supports business-critical data and analytics initiatives that enable strategic and operational decision-making across multiple regions and business functions. Thanks to its close relationship with its client, employees benefit from the scale, complexity, and career opportunities of a large multinational organization while enjoying the agility, accessibility, and human-sized culture of a smaller consultancy structure.

Jobomschrijving

As a Data Engineer / BI Consultant, you will contribute to the design, development, maintenance, and optimization of the organization's data ecosystem.Your responsibilities will include:

• Developing, maintaining, and optimizing data pipelines within a Snowflake environment.
• Working with SQL and Linux/Bash to support data integration, automation, and transformation processes.
• Implementing and maintaining solutions within a modern Data Mesh architecture combining Data Lake and Data Warehouse principles.
• Ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of data flows and reporting solutions.
• Collaborating closely with international business stakeholders located across multiple countries and time zones.
• Gathering business requirements and translating them into sustainable and efficient data solutions.
• Supporting the continuous improvement of reporting, analytics, and Business Intelligence capabilities.
• Contributing to data quality, governance, and optimization initiatives.
• Participating in ongoing projects related to cloud data platforms and digital transformation.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with excellent communication skills and enjoys working in an international environment.We are looking for someone who can demonstrate:

• 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing, or a similar domain.
• Hands-on experience with Snowflake at an intermediate level.
• Strong knowledge of:
• SQL
• Linux/Bash
• Data Factory
• Experience working with business stakeholders and translating functional requirements into technical solutions.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with international teams.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
The following skills would be considered an advantage:

• Experience with Data Mesh architectures.
• Knowledge of Power BI.
• Experience with Matillion.
• Experience with Teradata.
Languages:

• English is mandatory.
• French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets.

Our small and dynamic team of 7 is looking for a Finance & Administration Consultant to join us in Brussels for an initial 3-months part-time assignment. 

In this role, tasks will include:

• Invoicing and payment follow-up / Monitoring, preparing and following up on invoice and recurring payments, ensuring timely processing and the correct upload of supporting documents to the financial platform.
• Processing supplier invoices and team expense claims, checking invoice accuracy and project-budget allocation, and following up on corrections where necessary.
• Support in preparing our annual financial audit / Collecting and organising accounting documentation, liaising with the external accountant, and supporting financial reporting and audit preparation.
• Administrative support in managing member relations, including follow-up of membership fees.
• Providing financial and administrative support for events, including monitoring participant payments and tracking event-related costs. 
The ideal freelance candidate is:

• Experienced in financial administration
• Highly organized, reliable and detail-oriented
• Quick to understand digital tools, financial systems, and administrative processes.
• Fluent in English (spoken and written, C1), with a good command of French or Dutch
• Available for approx. 16 hours per week, starting 1 February 2027 
• Hybrid working, with one day per week on average in our Brussels office
• Depending on performance, an extension or longer-term collaboration is possible

As a reach truck driver, you are one of the most important links in the Katoen Natie warehouse in Ghent. You are responsible for storing and preparing valuable materials. Using the reach truck, you regularly stock goods on high racks. This requires an eye for detail and safety.

 

Profile

• Physical work doesn't put you off, you like to roll up your sleeves

• You work 60% on the reachtruck and 40% other tasks in the warehouse

• You ideally have extensive experience with the reach truck (at least 1 year); a certificate is a plus, but not a must

• To communicate effectively with your colleagues, it is important that you speak and understand Dutch or English or French

• You start in a day shift for training and then fulltime night shift

Do you have experience as a forklift driver?As the driver of the forklift truck with long forks, you are responsible for storing goods and loading/unloading the trucks. In addition, you sometimes help with other tasks in the warehouse (order picking, receiving, stock counting, etc.). For this, you will use a scanner.You will start in the Katoen Natie warehouses in Ghent.

Profile

• You have experience with a forklift truck with long forks (2m40) or you have extensive experience with a forklift truck with short forks and you see yourself driving the long-fork truck as well.

• A forklift certificate is not a requirement, experience is more important. There will be a theoretical and practical test

• To communicate effectively with your colleagues, you speak and understand Dutch or English well.

• You can work in a two-shift system

• You are motivated and reliable, and you prize safety and quality.

• You are flexible when it comes to hours and tasks

• In addition, you know how to use a scanner and a computer

Ready to kick-start your logistics career? On behalf of our client Katoen Natie, we're seeking motivated Order Pickers / Warehouse Employees for their dynamic operations in Gent Zeehaven. This is a temporary contract with excellent potential for permanent employment - your chance to prove yourself while learning from industry experts.

As an order picker, you'll be a crucial link in the international logistics chain, handling valuable materials and ensuring smooth operations for clients worldwide. This versatile role offers the perfect opportunity to develop your skills in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.

• 

• YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Order Picking: Accurately collect goods from warehouse locations using picking lists and handheld scanners

Quality Control: Inspect items for damage and ensure correct quantities before processing

Packing & Preparation: Prepare orders for shipping, including proper packaging and labeling

Receiving: Unload deliveries, check incoming goods, and update inventory systems

Inventory Management: Organize stock locations and maintain warehouse cleanliness

Safety Compliance: Follow all safety protocols and maintain a secure working environment

Team Collaboration: Work effectively with colleagues across different shifts

Continuous Improvement: Suggest ways to optimize processes and increase efficiency

• Essential Requirements:
Basic logistics experience (warehouse, order picking, packing, production) OR strong willingness to learn

Enthusiastic attitude combined with a hands-on mentality - ready to roll up your sleeves!

Reliability and punctuality - your team depends on you

Eye for detail and quality - accuracy is crucial in our operations

Physical fitness - comfortable standing, walking, and lifting throughout your shift

Availability for 2-shift system (early and late shifts)

Basic Dutch or English communication skills

What Makes You Stand Out:

Experience with warehouse management systems (WMS) or scanning equipment

Forklift or reach truck certification (or willingness to obtain)

Previous experience in international logistics or port operations

Multilingual skills for our diverse, international workplace

Positive team player attitude with problem-solving mindset

We're seeking an experienced Warehouse Team Leader to join our operations team at our state-of-the-art facility in Gent Zeehaven. Team Leadership: Coach and motivate warehouse staff to consistently achieve operational KPIs and quality standards

Operational Planning: Create efficient work schedules, allocate resources, and optimize workflow processes

Hands-On Management: Lead by example - work directly with your team using forklifts and warehouse equipment when needed

Performance Management: Monitor team performance, provide feedback, and implement improvement initiatives

Critical Decision Making: Make quick, effective decisions during peak periods and tight deadline situations

Safety & Compliance: Ensure all safety protocols and quality standards are maintained at all times

Physical stamina for hands-on warehouse work and extended periods on your feet

Flexible schedule - ability to work various shifts including occasional weekends

Problem-solving mindset with ability to make decisions under pressure

Experience with WMS (Warehouse Management Systems)

Lean/Six Sigma certification or continuous improvement experience

Just graduated and have recently obtained your bachelor's degree? Interested in a leadership role? Our client, Katoen Natie in Ghent, has a vacancy for a Supply Chain Trainee.

 

 

Grow into a leadership position with the Supply Chain Traineeship

 

 

As a Supply Chain Trainee, you will have the opportunity to advance to a leadership role within one of our logistics operations within a span of 2 years. Your logistics career will take off with an extensive on-the-job training program lasting approximately 2 years. The emphasis is on developing operational skills, leadership qualities, and specialization.

 

A diverse journey.

 

 

Throughout this exploratory experience, you will have the chance to become familiar with various operations and clients. This will enable you to discover the possibilities available to you within the company. There will be a total of 4 evaluation moments during the program. Depending on your competencies and interests, you may progress to a leadership position, such as a team leader overseeing a team/department and being responsible for guiding and coaching your team within a specific department.

 

 

 

• You have obtained a bachelor's degree in logistics, business or business management, trade, etc.

• Or you have an A2 diploma with relevant work experience, such as team leader, shift leader, supervisor, logistics employee, forklift driver, ambitious warehouse employee, etc.

• You speak fluent English and Dutch

• You are a true people manager and enjoy leading others.

• You can remain calm in stressful situations and are willing to make decisions.

• You have a hands-on mentality and are willing to actively get things done.

• You are willing to invest in yourself, you are driven and eager to learn.

• You are flexible in terms of working hours (shifts) and tasks.

We are currently looking for a motivated Terberg - Tugmaster driver (CE driver) for internal transport at Katoen Natie Gent. In this role, you will be responsible for safely and efficiently carrying out internal transport using a Terberg - Tugmaster tractor. You will be involved in moving goods and materials within our logistics environment and ensuring they are delivered to the correct locations.

 

 

• Operating the Terberg - Tugmaster tractor to move goods and materials within the facility.

• Loading and unloading trucks using the Terberg - Tugmaster tractor.

• Carefully checking goods and materials to ensure they match the corresponding documentation.

• Recording completed tasks and keeping track of inventory levels.

• Compliance with safety regulations and ensuring a safe working environment.

 

 

 

• Demonstrable experience as a Terberg - Tugmaster driver or operating similar tractors.

• You have a valid CE driver's license and code 95.

• Knowledge of applicable laws and regulations regarding internal transport.

• Familiarity with safety regulations and the ability to apply them correctly.

• Good communication skills in Dutch and/or English to effectively interact with colleagues.

• You are motivated and reliable and value safety and quality.

• You are flexible regarding hours and tasks.

• Willingness to work in two shifts or nightshift

• Good physical condition and capable of performing prolonged seated work.

• Attention to detail and precise execution of tasks.

• Expirience with a forklift long vorks is a plus!

Ready to start straight away in a full-time meat production role near Oosterzele, with no weekend shifts? Explore this opportunity in food production.

A food production workplace focused on meat products.

What you’ll do

• Help process meat products as part of the production work.
• Weigh products carefully.
• Pack products ready for the next stage.
Your working week runs from 6:00 am to 3:00 pm, Monday to Thursday, and from 6:00 am to 12:15 pm on Friday.

Forum Jobs connects people and businesses through a personal approach and broad knowledge across sectors. As a full-service HR partner, it supports both candidates and employers, bringing that understanding to each recruitment opportunity.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem and Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.CFM International is a 50/50 joint company between GE and Safran Aircraft Engines. For more information, visit us on the Web at www.cfmaeroengines.com or follow us on Twitter @CFM_engines.

The Logistic Warehouse Officer is responsible for the physical flow, the IT flow and the traceability of parts and modules in the preparation area before assembly and in the warehouse. He works in a production environment and reports to the Completion Manager, who in turn reports to the Supply Chain Director.Your role:

• You provide logistical support for production, where needed, and anticipate the needs for the realization of the 'Shop Visit' of modules and engines.
• You manage the incoming flow of engine parts in production by ensuring their traceability.
• You ensure the management of priorities vis-à-vis the modules to be prepared and released.
• You guarantee the cleanliness and correct packaging of the parts in the store.
• You follow the work and safety instructions specific to the workstation and the company.
• You respect the internal quality regulations and the rules of logistics and administrative management of the company.
• You stimulate the sharing of knowledge in the group.
• You take initiatives and make proposals in the context of continuous improvement, pro-actively evaluate, coordinate the improvement of current work methods and new technologies as they arise.You maintain constructive and effective relations with production, configurators and other colleagues.

Your profile:

• You hold a higher secondary or technical education degree or have equivalent experience, with a basic understanding of logistics. A degree in logistics or a related field is a strong advantage.
• You are proficient in IT tools (Word, Excel, ERP) and hold a valid license for lifting equipment.
• You strive to become fully operational and autonomous within six months, following a period of training and learning.
• You possess strong communication skills, practical thinking, and initiative, while actively contributing to continuous improvement efforts.
• You are a team player with an open and adaptable mindset.
• You work in a two-shift system: one week from 6 a.m. to 2 p.m., followed by a week from 2 p.m. to 10 p.m.
• You are fluent in either French or Dutch, have at least a basic understanding of the second national language, and with a good level of English.
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.
